headline: Space Industry Needs Economic Infrastructure Says Nebex CEO
summary: Tejpaul Bhatia, the CEO of Nebex, said that his company, which is aimed at building a financial operating system for the space industry, saw an economic gap in the growth of space travel as more money is put into the growth of the commercial space industry. Bhatia compared the potential of a space economy to the role of American Express and Wells Fargo at the beginning of the railroad industry.

headline: Suddenly, Wells Fargo Appears to Be Winning the Recruiting Wars
summary: Only a few years removed from a wave of scandals, Wells Fargo says it is on track to have its best recruiting year on record.

headline: Wells Fargo & Company Increases Common Stock Dividend
summary: SAN FRANCISCO, July 28, 2026--Wells Fargo & Company (NYSE: WFC) today announced its board of directors approved a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.50 per share, payable Sept. 1, 2026, to stockholders of record on Aug. 7, 2026. The third quarter dividend represents an increase of $0.05 per share, or 11%, from the prior quarter.

headline: Wells Fargo cuts Levi Strauss to Equal Weight after rally, flags limited upside
summary: Investing.com -- Wells Fargo downgraded Levi Strauss to Equal Weight from Overweight while maintaining its $25 price target, saying the apparel maker's strong share-price rally and earnings outperformance have largely been reflected in its valuation, leaving a more balanced risk-reward profile.
